## Deterministic entity dedupe and strict ontology extraction

You can now control how Zep deduplicates and classifies entities as your graph
grows. Custom entity types accept identity properties: when Zep extracts an
entity whose identity values match an existing node, the two are merged
deterministically instead of relying on similarity. You can also add entities
to a graph, thread, or batch in strict ontology mode, which limits extraction
to the entity types you have defined and drops generic entities.

Read the docs

## Clearer billing errors in the dashboard

Billing and account pages now show a single friendly error message when a
billing action fails, instead of surfacing raw internal errors. This affects
the billing page, account deletion, and the billing portal link.

## Custom instructions availability

The custom instructions documentation now reflects that the feature is available
to Flex Plus and Enterprise customers.
